theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_ls_mollify_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ψ g : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : NNReal), Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ ψ x) → ∫ x, ψ x = 1 → LipschitzWith K g → LipschitzWith K (fun x => ∫ y, ψ y * g (x - y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
